_comment: Family Meeting 🔥 chat banks, off-screen events (abilities spec §5) and in-vehicle banter. ALL Pidgin lines PENDING NATIVE-SPEAKER REVIEW. Events are cosmetic or economic only and never touch story state.

p4_dark.text: Nobody touches my jollof pot. NOBODY.
DJ? DJ!! Generator? …Generator is ALSO in the dark?!

p4_morning.text: Sule, you texted? Since when do you text?
Okay. Today we work. Forget yesterday. Forget the Chief. Forget the bag.

m15_group.text: KC added Tunde, Aunty Boss, Sule
Who added me to this rubbish?
Change the name. We are not family.
We are now 🙏🏾 The bag made us family
Fine. Rule 1: no voice notes longer than 1 minute. Rule 2: you all owe me for dinner.

tunde.text: Tunde, can I film the danfo for my next skit?
Only if you pay fare like a normal human being
Sule, three words! Proud of you 🥹
Tunde. You owe me ₦3,500 for pepper soup.
Aunty, I'm coming to work it off. Baba God dey!
Baba God does not pay my debts.

ngozi.text: Food is ready. Money is also ready to receive.
Ah. Can I pay with likes?
Nobody in Lagos greets for free. Talk.
Market council meeting at 4. Everybody behave.
If you value your phone, no.

kc.text: He is sleeping. His status says sleeping since 10am.
that was a skit about sleeping 😭
NEW VIDEO OUT 🔥🔥 link in bio
Aunty don't click it, it will finish your data
KC your phone is on 2% again isn't it
Because you're typing like a man drowning.

offscreen.title: While you were away…
offscreen.text: LARDO towed Baba God Dey for "parking with attitude". ₦3,000 to collect it. Officer Gbenga says hi.

offscreen.title: While you were away…
offscreen.text: Aunty Boss started a dispute with a pepper seller. It is now a case at the market council. She is winning.

offscreen.title: While you were away…
offscreen.text: KC went viral for the wrong reason: someone filmed him falling into a gutter while filming a sunset. New nickname: "Gutter Vibes".

offscreen.title: While you were away…
offscreen.text: KC's skit about NEPA bills went viral. A fictional brand slid into his DMs.

offscreen.title: While you were away…
offscreen.text: Quiet day. Small side hustles. Small money. Baba God dey.

offscreen.title: While you were away…
offscreen.text: A relative called with "na small request": ₦5,000 for "something urgent". It was sent. Nobody knows what the urgent thing was.

owambe_guests: Guest: "This bus smells of fish."  Tunde: "That's the smell of hard work, madam."
Guest: "Driver, is this the fastest route?"  Tunde: "Every route is the fastest route if you believe."
Guest: "My gele is touching the roof. Drive gently!"
Guest: "If we miss the couple's entrance, I'm telling everybody it was your fault."
Guest: "Adeleke, your shoe is shining more than the groom's future."
debates: Passenger 1: "Eko Thunder will win the league."  Passenger 2: "Eko Thunder can't even win a coin toss."
Passenger: "Fuel price will come down next week."  Everybody: "HAHAHA."
Passenger 1: "My pastor can pray for rain."  Passenger 2: "My pastor can pray for NEPA."  Everybody: "…Now that one is a miracle."
Passenger: "Driver, why are you driving like you're running from your landlord?"
Passenger 1: "Jollof is a Nigerian invention."  Passenger 2: "Agreed. The rest of the world is copying."
Passenger: "Driver, reduce the volume of that Fuji."  Tunde: "Madam, this Fuji is keeping my BP down. Leave it."
Passenger: "In this Lagos, you must hustle or the hustle will hustle you."
Passenger: "My neighbour's generator is louder than my thoughts."
chase: Passenger: "Driver, why is that car following us?"  Tunde: "Fans."
Passenger (filing nails): "Driver, do your thing. I have paid."
Passenger: "Shortcut dey!"  Tunde: "Don't say that. Every time somebody says that, wahala follows."
